title: Jamf Pro (Jamf Pro API, API client with Read Computers and View MDM command information)
readScopes: A Jamf Pro API client whose only API role holds two privileges: "Read Computers" (GET /api/v4/computers-inventory, falling back to v3, v2 or v1) and, since 2026-11-07, "View MDM command information in Jamf Pro API" (GET /api/v2/mdm/commands); its client id and secret are JAMF_CLIENT_ID and JAMF_CLIENT_SECRET, exchanged at POST /api/v1/oauth/token.

checks.title: Each Mac's boot partition is encrypted with FileVault 2
checks.scope: Every computer in Jamf Pro, one result per computer, from bootPartitionEncryptionDetails.partitionFileVault2State (ENCRYPTED passes) or else fileVault2Enabled.

checks.title: Each Mac runs macOS at or above the given minimum version
checks.scope: Every computer, against --jamf-min-os; without that option the check is skipped. Apple's support dates are not looked up.

checks.title: Each Mac has submitted inventory to Jamf Pro within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every computer, from general.reportDate; the window is --jamf-inventory-days.

checks.title: Each Mac is under Jamf Pro remote management
Each Mac or mobile device erased in the period has a finished erase recorded
checks.scope: One result per device with an ERASE_DEVICE command sent within --jamf-wipe-days (default 365): ACKNOWLEDGED passes; ERROR or COMMAND_FORMAT_ERROR fails; PENDING or NOT_NOW for more than 7 days fails. A computer is named by its Jamf id and serial when the inventory carries its management id. A device retired without an erase is not seen.
